review.imagery: Root visually reviewed all8 native scenes and the43-spread index. The phase3 frontal render is its own card image. Shared Gate3/4 corner, pool, gym and interiors retain collection scope. Aljada scenes retain community scope. Generic lifestyle imagery was excluded.
review.floorPlans: Root visually reviewed all27 complete staged source spreads and all41 enlarged final numeric panels. Twenty-six choices include every residence type, all eight building floors and both masters. Printed totals and type labels were manually read. Original source notices and whole drawings are unchanged.
review.location: Root reviewed the exact red Gate3 footprint and the full regional/community maps. Regional physical5 shows5-minute Madar walk and10/25/30-minute Sharjah-airport/Dubai-airport/Downtown drives. Physical6 gives5/20-minute airport estimates. Conflict explicitly retained, no coordinate inferred.

Archive provenance remains explicit. No source alteration, access bypass or enquiry. Canonical research and protected ownership preserved.
